title: Output Parameters
description: Learn how to use OUTPUT parameters to return data from stored procedures.

data.text: Output parameters allow a stored procedure to return data back to the calling program. To create an output parameter, use the OUTPUT keyword in the parameter definition.

data.title: Stored procedure with output parameter
data.content: Creates a procedure that returns the count of products for a model year.

data.text: Note that if you forget the OUTPUT keyword after the variable, the variable will be NULL.

data.title: Output Parameters Key Points
points: Output parameters use the OUTPUT keyword in the procedure definition.
Callers must also use OUTPUT when passing the variable.
